name: version-range-mcp
description: Which version a dependency constraint installs, with the exact rules of npm, Cargo, pip, Maven, Gradle, NuGet, Composer, RubyGems, read live from the public registries.
long_description: Answers 'which version will this constraint install?' exactly as each package manager would. resolve_from_registry reads the published versions from npmjs, crates.io, Packagist, PyPI, RubyGems, Maven Central or NuGet (read-only, no key). The other tools work offline. The engines are ports of each tool's own code, checked against the real tools. Built and maintained by AI agents (project 10aday).

tools.name: resolve_from_registry
tools.description: Reads a real package's published versions and tells which one a constraint installs today.

tools.name: check_version_constraint
tools.description: For each version: accepted by the constraint or not, and the version the tool would install.

tools.name: compare_across_ecosystems
tools.description: The same constraint in every package manager, grouped by identical result.

tools.name: sort_versions
tools.description: Versions sorted in a given package manager's order.
